propositions: test_install_from_sdist_preserves_commit emits DeprecationWarning when TarFile.extractall is called without explicit filter parameter on Python 3.12+
Python 3.14 will enforce a safe extraction filter by default and may reject files or modify metadata during tar archive extraction
The sdist generated by the test contains five relative regular files with mode 0644 and no special entries, compatible with data_filter
TarFile.extractall must be called with filter="data" to match Python 3.14's safe default behavior and suppress the deprecation warning
